name: asciify-engine
description: Framework-agnostic ASCII art engine. Convert images, videos, and GIFs into ASCII art with 13 art styles, 10 animated backgrounds, and interactive hover effects. Zero dependencies.

paragraphs: A framework-agnostic ASCII art rendering engine for the browser. Convert images, animated GIFs, and video into character-based art rendered onto an HTML canvas — with full color support, interactive hover effects, living-image motion, 24 Studio render styles, and export.
This separation means you can pre-compute frames once and render them at any frame rate, making it efficient for both static images and smooth animations.
features: Convert — a source (image, GIF buffer, video element) is sampled and converted into an AsciiFrame: a 2D array of character cells, each carrying a character and RGBA color data.
Render — the frame is drawn onto a element via a 2D context, with full support for color modes, font sizes, hover effects, and time-based animations.
